title: [#17517] capinfos: machine-readable filetype/encap
description:
When using the `-M` or `-T` options, show machine-readable values for
the file type and the file encapsulation. Update the man page
accordingly.

Closes #17517

commits_data.title: Use machine-readable encaps in test suite
commits_data.message:
Use machine-readable encaps in test suite

The tests which involve `capinfos` pass the `-M` argument, so the output
tests need to change to test for the machine-readable encapsulation
strings, rather than the human-readable ones.
